obligationUnits.heading: Units
obligationUnits.lede: The clauses and controls you work with, by your own reference and in your own words. Each has its own applicability, reason and status.
obligationUnits.entityHint: Only legal entities where this standard applies are listed.
obligationUnits.entityHintOthers: Only legal entities where this standard applies are listed. Not listed: {entities}.
obligationUnits.created: {count, plural, one {# unit created.} other {# units created.}}
obligationUnits.locked: Reference and title are fixed: this unit has history.
obligationUnits.emptyBody: Add the clauses and controls you work with, one by one or pasted from your own list.
obligationUnits.noEntityTitle: No legal entity follows this standard
obligationUnits.noEntityBody: Set "Applies" for a legal entity under Does it apply to us on this obligation. Its units can be listed here after that.
obligationUnits.title: Your title
obligationUnits.titleHint: In your own words, as your own list has it. Do not copy the standard's text.
obligationUnits.removeBody: "{title}" leaves the list. It has no decisions, so nothing else changes.
obligationUnits.problemDuplicate: {entity} already has a unit with this reference.
obligationUnits.problemScope: {entity} does not follow this standard, so it cannot have units. Set "Applies" for it on the obligation first.
obligationUnits.problemStandard: Units exist only under a standard.
obligationUnits.problemHistory: This unit has history, so its reference and title are fixed.
obligationUnits.problemStale: Someone changed this unit while you were editing. Reload to see their version, then make your change again.
obligationUnits.pasteHint: Your reference, a tab, your title. Add a tab, "{applies}" or "{doesNotApply}" and a tab and a reason to decide at once.
obligationUnits.pasteHintNoDecisions: Your reference, a tab, your title.
obligationUnits.readyHeading: {count, plural, one {# unit to create} other {# units to create}}
obligationUnits.refusedHeading: {count, plural, one {# line refused and left out} other {# lines refused and left out}}
obligationUnits.refusedDuplicate: An earlier line already uses this reference.
obligationUnits.refusedExists: {entity} already has a unit with this reference.
obligationUnits.refusedEmpty: The line has no reference or no title.
obligationUnits.refusedDecision: "{value}" is not a decision. Use "{applies}" or "{doesNotApply}", or leave it out.
obligationUnits.decisionsLeftOut: The decisions are left out: setting applicability needs applicability approve.
obligationUnits.confirmTitle: {count, plural, one {Set # decision for {entity}?} other {Set # decisions for {entity}?}}
obligationUnits.confirmBody: The units are created and each decision is stored in your name with its reason. Each is kept in the audit log.
obligationUnits.decisionsFailed: The units were created, but their decisions were not stored. Try again to store them.
